notes: Standalone 26m37s diagnostic, not an Enigma manufacturing selection. 18×14×6.8 mm arch, 3 walls, 100% infill, 4 mm brim, PVA body/interface supports with zero contact gaps and a prime tower. Manual logical map 2,1 with unchanged factory physical map 1,0 matches actual AMS physical 0,1. Static generated targets PLA 220 C / PVA 240 C. Actual feed, temperatures, adhesion and cleanup remain to be observed. All estimates separate from unknown measured actuals. Single start command accepted SUCCESS with exact file, MD5 and plate. Fresh independent telemetry confirmed RUNNING at layer 0, bed heating; extrusion and physical success still pending. Initial combined ack snapshot retained an old FAILED field; this was not interpreted as a fresh terminal outcome. TERMINAL: FINISH first observed 2026-10-26 19:05:36 UTC, all 34 layers, 100%, no active print error; the preceding 19:04:38 observation was still RUNNING. Exact end time and measured duration/filament remain unknown. A fresh 19:06 camera shows the blue arch and separate prime tower still on the bed, with pale support material visible. No obvious tangled pile or detached model is visible. Support dissolution/removal, drying, dimensional and bonding inspection are pending; this does not qualify Enigma manufacturing or establish full per-tool firmware thermal behavior. The earlier AMS-HT feed-resistance entry was absent from the terminal report; physical resolution is not inferred from its disappearance.
